thread:
emma: quick question — before we ship the next pricing page AB, can we land on a single experiment plan? planning to test FAQ reorder + new tier names + an inline calculator CTA + different inbound routing for demo requests. thoughts? :wave:
ryan: yes — want to keep it small. my priority: make it clear which tier is for low-latency vs committed throughput. current names are confusing. :thinking:
maria: agree. propose swapping labels to more outcome-focused names instead of numeric (e.g., Core / Scale / Platinum). language should say: 'best for X' on hover. small microcopy change could move conversions. :sparkles:
alex: from sales: if we route demo requests from the middle tier straight to SDRs (instead of CS), conversion velocity went up in Jan. so test routing variant: SDR vs CS. also ask: can calculator capture expected monthly tokens? we need that to qualify leads.
omar: @emma small note: can we A/B the FAQ order so 'security & compliance' appears first for enterprise traffic? that helped on the Private product page.
oliver: analytics: I can track micro-conversions. suggest event names: `pricing_page.view`, `pricing_calc.submission`, `demo_request.source`. want a snippet for the calculator payload?
emma: yes please, oliver. also for the inline calc microcopy — short line under inputs saying "estimate monthly cost — results are approximate". keeps legal happy.
oliver: ok here's a minimal payload we'll ask front-end to emit: ```{ "monthly_tokens": 500000, "model_choice": "redwood-3b", "batching": "standard" }```
maria: copy note: change CTA text variants — "Calculate my cost" vs "Estimate cost & chat" — would prefer the latter for demo capture.
alex: +1 for "Estimate cost & chat" — drives demos. route those submissions to SDR queue tag `pricing-demo`.
nora: support/ops: make sure demo routing includes a checkbox for "need SOC2/contract" so SDRs can prioritize. otherwise tickets flood CS.
emma: good call. final checklist for the experiment: 1) swap tier labels to outcome names and add one-line descriptors, 2) reorder FAQ w/ security first for enterprise, 3) add inline calculator with two CTA variants, 4) split demo routing SDR vs CS, 5) capture `monthly_tokens` and `interest_tag` in payload. can we freeze copy by EOD? :eyes:
ryan: i can lock variants and send final to design in 2 hours. i'll add experiment flags in LaunchDarkly.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: pricing-page/feature-flags updated by ryan — feature-branch `pricing-ab-clarity` — CI passing. :white_check_mark:
emma: awesome. oliver — once live can you validate events and set funnels? prioritize pages with UTM `pricing_experiment_march`
oliver: on it. will post a quick dashboard link when data starts coming in.
maria: i'll prepare microcopy doc and two CTA screenshots now. cc @design for the inline calc UI.
emma: thanks all — syncing again tomorrow 10am to review early signals. :thumbsup:
